title: Survey strange country
summary: {giver} is collecting surveys of the world's strangest land: a fire mountain, a table mountain, a salt flat or a painted canyon. Stand on one and bring back a survey.
offer: I collect the strange places of the world. A mountain that breathes fire, a table of stone above the forest, a plain of salt, a canyon banded like cloth. Survey any one for me.
complete: Wonderful. This goes in the atlas.
